blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Saturday highlighted the unequal distribution of multi-purpose building (MPB) projects among local governments, noting that most are built in high-income cities and municipalities. Lacson raised the issue while questioning the allocation for MPBs under the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 2027 budget, which was endorsed by Senate finance committee chair Sen. JV Ejercito. According to DPWH data, the government funded 79,816 MPBs nationwide from 2012 to 2026, at a total cost of P760 billion.
